description: This file defines the abstract base class 'AbstractRealDistribution' for real-valued probability distributions, providing default implementations for probability calculations, sampling, and other common operations, making it a core component within the 'org.apache.commons.math3.distribution' package.

classes.name: AbstractRealDistribution
classes.description: An abstract base class for probability distributions over the real numbers, providing default implementations for common operations like probability calculation, sampling, and inverse cumulative probability.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Deprecated method calculating probability between two points, defaulting to 'probability(double, double)'.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a random variable falls between x0 (exclusive) and x1 (inclusive).

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse cumulative distribution function (quantile function) with root bracketing, using solver techniques.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a sample from the distribution using inverse transform sampling.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates an array of samples of specified size.

methods.name: reseedRandomGenerator
methods.description: Resets the internal random number generator with a new seed.
